description:
Unsigned calldata for on-chain actions. No action: every action and its
    params. action (e.g. 'notary/notarize', 'swap/exact_in') + args: the
    transactions and preconditions; your wallet signs and sends.
    action='sign': the off-chain texts to sign (game actions). Prepared, not
    executed; the meter never sees a key.
name: prepare
